title: Finance Business Partner
company: Three Bridges Recruitment LTD - Agency - Permanent
description:
We are working with a leading Scottish charity to recruit a Finance Business Partner for an initial 6-month contract with the possibility of extension. This is a key role within the Finance team, supporting a values-driven organisation dedicated to empowering people across Scotland to live meaningful & fulfilling lives.

Reporting to the Head of Finance, you will play a key role across several finance projects, with a particular focus on budgeting & forecasting, management accounts, restricted funds, reporting & financial modelling. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can quickly understand what is needed, take ownership of their work & add value from the outset.

Why work here?
- Salary of £47,000 - £51,000 pro rata
- Initial 6-month contract with the possibility of extension
- Be part of a respected Scottish charity with a strong sense of purpose & clear values
- Enjoy flexibility & work-life balance - primarily remote working, with travel a few times per month
- Excellent benefits - over 32 days annual leave, up to 9% employer pension contribution, enhanced sick pay & life assurance
- 35 hours per week
- Join a collaborative finance team committed to innovation, accuracy, & adding value
- Opportunity to take ownership of meaningful finance projects & make an impact quickly

Job

As Finance Business Partner, you will:
- Work closely with the Head of Finance across a range of key finance activities & projects
- Prepare & consolidate forecasts & budgets
- Support the production of monthly management accounts alongside the Head of Finance
- Set up & monitor the charity's restricted funds
- Interpret business reporting needs & develop financial reports, data analysis & operational KPIs
- Provide financial insight to help ensure finance processes & outputs are understood, followed & responsive to the needs of the organisation
- Develop & maintain costing & other financial models
- Work with all colleagues to understand requirements & communicate information clearly
- Identify opportunities to improve financial systems, reporting & processes
- Manage competing priorities & deliver accurate work within tight deadlines

You

As Finance Business Partner, you will:
- Bring strong technical & analytical skills with a proactive, collaborative approach
- Have experience developed in a similar or equivalent finance role
- Have strong budgeting, forecasting & management accounting experience
- Have experience of systems optimisation & improving financial processes
- Have practical experience applying accounting regulations
- Be proficient in specialist financial systems & Microsoft applications, particularly Excel
- Have experience working within a large or complex organisation
- Be able to interpret complex financial information & communicate it in a clearly
- Be highly motivated, adaptable & comfortable managing competing deadlines
- Have strong interpersonal skills, with confidence to work with all stakeholders
- Bring demonstrable negotiation & conflict resolution skills
- Ideally have experience within the not-for-profit sector, although this is not essential
- Be available to start as soon as possible & within four weeks

At Three Bridges Recruitment, two of our values are "striving for brilliance" & "relatability". We want every applicant to receive an excellent experience & ensure that this opportunity is the right fit for you. Should this role be of interest, please apply with your most up-to-date CV or contact us for a confidential discussion.

title: Service Advisor
company: Perfect Placement Uk Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
We are recruiting on behalf of a well-established automotive business in Stirling for the position of Service Advisor. This role offers an excellent opportunity for skilled motor trade professionals to join a reputable company with clear career progression. The Service Advisor will play a vital role in delivering exceptional customer service and maintaining the high standards of the business.

Benefits:
- Competitive basic salary up to £33,150, depending on experience
- OTE approximately £38,000, based on performance
- Monday to Friday working hours, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm
- One in three Saturday mornings as part of the rota
- Supportive management and ongoing training
- Opportunities for professional development within a stable, well-known automotive company
- Work in a friendly and professional environment with a loyal customer base

Duties of a Service Advisor:
- Handle customer enquiries and queries promptly and professionally
- Qualify service needs and diagnose vehicle issues where applicable
- Establish understanding and agreement with customers regarding work to be carried out
- Explain work undertaken on vehicles in a clear manner ensuring full customer understanding and approval
- Ensure all work and customer interactions comply with manufacturer standards and company policies
- Maintain accurate records and relevant systems at all times
- Support the team with additional Customer Service tasks as needed

Requirements of a Service Advisor:
- Previous experience in an automotive role, ideally as a Service Advisor or related position
- Strong organisational and communication skills
- Excellent customer service skills with a professional attitude
- Knowledge of common vehicle issues and understanding of the motor trade environment
- Ability to work within a team and handle customer queries efficiently
- Flexibility to work one in three Saturdays and adhere to scheduled hours

Contact Will Grant, Automotive Recruitment Specialist at Perfect Placement covering Stirling and Stirlingshire, today to discover more about this fantastic Service Advisor opportunity.
